name: Mix two decks with the crossfader
description: Verifies both decks can be started independently and the visible mixer state responds to crossfader movement.
steps: Move the CROSSFADER fully toward A and then fully toward B
expected: Both deck buttons can enter PAUSE state, AUDIO ENGINE READY is visible, and mixer state changes between DECK A / FULL and DECK B / FULL.

name: Mute and restore master output
description: Verifies the master control can deliberately mute the mixer and restore output without affecting deck controls.
expected: The footer shows MASTER MUTE at zero and returns to a numeric MASTER percentage after the volume is restored.

name: Use both decks on mobile
description: Verifies the stacked mobile console remains usable and exposes both deck and mixer controls.
steps: Tap PLAY A and PLAY B
Move the CROSSFADER from center toward B
expected: Deck A, mixer, and Deck B are stacked without horizontal overflow, both play buttons remain usable, and mixer state changes toward B.
